sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No. 56 of 2023, arising out of Kabisuryanagar P.S. Case No. 224 of 2023 pending before the Court of the learned Addl. District Judge- cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376 of IPC, r/w Section 4 of POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned ADJ-cum-Spl. Judge under POCSO Act, Berhampur, by order dated 03.07.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. Taking into account the tenor thereof, this Court is not inclined to entertain this application at this stage.

6. Leave is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer after examination of the victim.
7.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Soumya Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
